name: form-field
title: FormField
description: A small form composition primitive for real app forms. It connects labels, descriptions, errors, required state, and accessible control ids while supporting stacked, inline, split, card, section, and action layouts around existing inputs, selects, textareas, switches, and checkboxes.
author: Wensity <hello@wensity.com>

theme.font-sans: var(--font-satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif)

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/form-field.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add form-field.
